question: Deploy MV3DT on my calibrated 4-camera MP4 dataset. Which skill and deployment path should be used? Do not run anything.
ground_truth: Generic MV3DT requests route to the standalone RT-CV-3D skill. The workflow uses services/rtvi/rt-cv-3d/rt-cv-mv3dt/docker/compose.yml, generates configs from calibration.json, stages INPUT_MODE=file, defaults to bundled mosquitto+kafka, and does not use warehouse compose files.
expected_behavior: Loads vss-deploy-detection-tracking-3d for generic MV3DT intent.
Identifies the standalone compose path under services/rtvi/rt-cv-3d/rt-cv-mv3dt/docker/compose.yml.

Uses bundled broker mode, but for file input runs bundled resource preflight before config generation/staging, verifies staged file-mode latency dropping is disabled, starts support services first, captures Kafka baselines, then starts perception with --no-deps instead of full-stack docker compose up -d.
Reports resolved runtime images only from docker compose config --images and does not hardcode a runtime image version.
Does not mention warehouse compose as the deployment path.
Does not print plaintext API tokens.

question: Run MV3DT on the sample dataset / 4-cam example dataset. Which workflow should be used? Do not run anything.
ground_truth: Sample MV3DT requests route to the standalone RT-CV-3D skill. The workflow uses NGC warehouse app-data for models/videos, repo sample calibration.json and Top.png for calibration and BEV map, generated transforms.yml, INPUT_MODE=file, NUM_CAMS=4, bundled brokers, saved grid video, and saved fused BEV output. It does not use warehouse blueprint compose unless the user explicitly asks for the full warehouse stack.
expected_behavior: Loads vss-deploy-detection-tracking-3d and the sample-dataset reference.
Uses the standalone compose path under services/rtvi/rt-cv-3d/rt-cv-mv3dt/docker/compose.yml.
Resolves existing app-data or asks for/downloads the NGC warehouse app-data resource without printing NGC keys.
Validates the exact sample model files required by runtime configs before launch.
Uses sample videos from warehouse-4cams-20mx20m-synthetic and sample camera ids Camera, Camera_01, Camera_02, Camera_03.
Uses the repo sample calibration.json and Top.png, then generates transforms.yml for BEV_DATASET_PATH.
Runs bundled resource preflight before config generation/staging and asserts the staged Kafka sink matches the selected KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP.
Plans saved perception grid and saved fused BEV by default for the finite file run.
Uses a same-session BEV recorder launch for finite file runs and verifies the recorder survives until perception starts.
Does not route to vss-deploy-profile or use warehouse compose commands.

ground_truth: Explicit warehouse MV3DT requests route away from the standalone RT-CV-3D skill to the warehouse/profile deployment skill and warehouse compose files.
expected_behavior: Routes explicit warehouse-blueprint MV3DT intent to vss-deploy-profile or the warehouse deployment references.
Explains that vss-deploy-detection-tracking-3d is the default for standalone MV3DT but not for combined warehouse deployment.
Does not instruct the user to use the standalone compose file for the full warehouse blueprint.

ground_truth: The standalone skill supports the basic external host:port broker path: validate endpoints, generate MQTT pub/sub config with MQTT_BROKERS, launch compose without bundled broker profiles, and verify Kafka against the external bootstrap. TLS/auth variants remain delegated to README.

Uses external-broker Compose mode without COMPOSE_PROFILES=mosquitto,kafka, while preserving file-mode baseline and BEV-prestart ordering when the input is file.
Requires mdx-raw and mdx-bev to be describable on the external Kafka bootstrap before launch.

question: Run rtvi-cv-3d on my synchronized cam_*.mp4 files, but I do not have calibration yet. Walk me through the order without running anything.
ground_truth: The skill identifies missing calibration, hands off to vss-generate-video-calibration first, requires successful AMC export, validates camera-only calibration sensors, returns to standalone config generation, staging, bundled broker mode, file-mode support-service/baseline ordering, and verification.
expected_behavior: Chains to vss-generate-video-calibration because calibration is missing.
Does not ignore a failed AMC export_calibration POST or silently reuse an old calibration.json.
Validates exported calibration JSON using camera-only sensors with safe unique ids.
Resolves BEV_DATASET_PATH only after map.png and transforms.yml are both present.
Uses standalone compose and bundled brokers for the deployment plan.
Does not mention warehouse calibration mount paths.
Does not print plaintext API tokens.
